title: Home Blood Pressure Log
about: A log for blood pressure readings taken at home, with the usual steps for an accurate reading. Bring it to the next visit.

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

blocks.label: For a good reading
items: Do not smoke, exercise or have caffeine for 30 minutes before.
Sit with your back supported and your feet flat on the floor. Rest for 5 minutes.
Rest your arm on a table, with the cuff on bare skin at the level of your heart.
Do not talk while the cuff is on.
Take 2 readings, 1 minute apart, and write both down.

blocks.text: Call us if your top number is often above your goal. If it is 180 or higher, or the bottom number is 120 or higher, wait 5 minutes and check again. If it is still that high and you have chest pain, shortness of breath, back pain, numbness, weakness, trouble seeing or trouble speaking, call 911.
